message.content:
This document is a technical README for **Project Maya**, a system for running large open-weight models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash) locally on consumer/prosumer hardware. Key technical points:

**Models & Quantization**
- Three model families with Maya-XS/S/M/L quant tiers (93–122 GB for GLM; DeepSeek ~350 GB; MiniMax ~95–200 GB).
- Quality measured against originals: GLM quants retain 97.7–99.2% zero-shot accuracy
